catalyst_stack: Noble added about $565 million of contract value on 2026-04-26, including a Petrobras extension of Noble Courage through December 2030, then roughly $200 million more on 2026-07-27 as backlog stood at $6.8 billion. Weatherford’s 2026-05-05 MPD alliance, Jeff Miller’s 2026-05-21 board appointment, and Citi/Susquehanna/Fearnley PT or rating actions through 2026-07-29 were secondary positives. The break was 2026-07-27: a $37 million Q2 loss, $43 million of Brazil idle costs on Faye Kozack and Courage, FY2026 EBITDA cut to $850–$925 million, and a $42 million Ocean Apex scrap impairment, followed by a 9.07% drop on 2026-07-28 and Barclays cutting its PT to $53 on 2026-07-30. Middle East tension and higher oil lifted offshore drillers, including Noble, on 2026-09-25, but that bounce does not reverse the H2 guidance reset.
key_assumption: The Brazil suspensions are a contained 2026 utilization hit already inside the lowered $850–$925 million EBITDA guide, not lasting Petrobras downtime or a franchise safety issue.
